source.author: verg
source.text: Per patrios manis et spes surgentis Iuli te precor, hanc animam serves natoque patrique.
source.text_original: 'Per patrios manis et spes surgentis Iuli / te precor, hanc animam serves natoque patrique.
source.text_english: By your father’s shades and the rising hope of Iulus, I beg you, preserve this life for your son and for his father.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: adiuratus enim per eundem patrem et spes surgentis Iuli, nequaquam pepercit tums accensus et ira.
reuse.text_original: adiuratus enim per eundem patrem et spes surgentis Iuli, nequaquam pepercit tums accensus et ira.
reuse.text_english: For, when he had been adjured by the same father and by the hope of the rising Julian house, then, inflamed with anger, he spared not at all.
